newsitem.title: UK: UK shares fall after Dow drop, Sainsbury warning.
newsitem.headline: UK shares fall after Dow drop, Sainsbury warning.

text.p: UK stocks opened sharply lower on on Friday after a late retreat on Wall Street and as supermarket stocks dropped after J Sainsbury warned the market to expect profits well below levels analysts had been predicting.
After setting a record close on Thursday, the FTSE 100 index was down 39.8 points at 4,23.7, with every stock in the blue chip index marked lower.
Sainsbury was down 33p at 359 and other supermarket stocks were also lower, with Safeway down 11-1/2p at 391, Tesco off 5p at 363 and ASDA down 2-1/4p at 122.
